provenance.note: An interpretation built from primitives, not a survey, a reconstruction or a likeness. The near-cubic granite block with its rounded, stepped crown, the arched window on each face, the corner figures, the stepped terrace and the low ring wall of repeating wagon-like segments stand for the monument; their dimensions are rounded to read well from a distance, not measured, and the figures are stylised silhouettes. No supplied 3D asset or camera path existed for this landmark; both are ours.

tourism.title: Voortrekker Monument
tourism.body: On a hill south of central Pretoria stands a granite monument completed in 1949. It commemorates the Voortrekkers, who left the Cape Colony in the 1830s and 1840s and moved into the interior of southern Africa.
